infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Karunada Kote Guide uses your location to detect nearby landmarks and automatically narrate their history as you explore the fort.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Karunada Kote Guide uses your camera to capture photo challenges at historic landmarks.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Karunada Kote Guide to use your location to detect nearby landmarks.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Karunada Kote Guide to access the camera for photo challenges.
